description: Angular component template for configuring time window settings in the Thingsboard UI, including real-time, history, and aggregation options.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Closes the dialog without applying changes.

methods.name: configureRealtimeLastIntervalOptions

methods.name: configureRealtimeQuickIntervalOptions
